body:
Founder real-time (2026-08-25): 'can we get pitviper to work with tmux pane scrolling?' -> 'using parena' / 'mod surface first' / 'api first' / 'fix with parena' -- explicit choice of the mod-surface route over a quick direct Go fix, continuing S189-32/S189-40's already-established 'mod surface first' policy (2026-08-20) rather than opening a new precedent.

Root cause: cmd/pitviper/main.go's sdl.MouseWheelEvent case had plain (non-Ctrl) wheel scroll as a documented, intentional no-op (stale comment: "PITVIPER has no scrollback buffer at all yet"). That's stale -- internal/vterm/scrollback.go and Page Up/Down's handleScrollKey already have a real scrollback mechanism (screen.ScrollBy/ScrollLines/ScrollReset).

Built: PITVIPER's first real Go<->PARENA cgo bridge (internal/scrollmod/), deliberately minimal -- no dispatch table, no plugin discovery, one function. stdlib/pitviper/vterm_mod.prn (on-wheel-scroll, I32 param, #target/inline-c FFI, same pattern as editor/plugin.prn's S189-29/34) compiles via 'parena build' to vterm_mod.c, linked into a new pitviper/internal/scrollmod Go package via cgo (#cgo CFLAGS: -include scrollmod_host.h, same "-include host declarations" pattern PARENA/examples/BUILD.bazel already established for editor_plugin_host_stubs.h). Go's SDL wheel-event handler calls scrollmod.TriggerWheelScroll -> compiled PARENA C's on_wheel_scroll -> cgo-exported pitviper_host_scroll -> registered ScrollCallback -> screen.ScrollBy, matching Page Up/Down's own sign convention. Gated behind -mod-scroll flag / PITVIPER_MOD_SCROLL=1 env var, off by default until founder verifies live, per S189-32(6)'s own rollout plan (verify -> mainline).

Verified live, not just compile-checked: new TestTriggerWheelScrollRoundTrip actually executes the full Go->cgo->PARENA-compiled-C->cgo-export->Go callback round trip and asserts the delta value survives it intact. go build ./..., go vet ./... (zero new warnings -- the one pre-existing renderDistrictPane lock-by-value warning is the same one already documented in commit 254fb39, unrelated), go test ./... all green. gofmt clean on every file I touched (two pre-existing unformatted files elsewhere, not touched here).

Real, honest scope limits: this is a v0 mod-surface with exactly one hook (wheel-scroll), not a general plugin system -- SAND/editor-plugin's own dispatch-table/config/command-palette scope is real, separate, unstarted work. A second, already-diagnosed bug (S189-32(7)/(8): Screen.Resize() never updates scrollRegTop/scrollRegBot, causing tmux/vim pane-scroll failures after a window resize) was deliberately NOT fixed here -- it's an internal invariant fix inside Resize() itself, not a response to an input event, so it has no natural "mod" shape; forcing it through this same pattern would be a worse fit than either fixing it directly (matching S189-36's precedent for well-understood, narrowly-scoped bugs) or leaving it for a dedicated follow-up. Flagged as S192-02 in EMILY/BACKLOG.md, not attempted here.

Built in an isolated git worktree specifically because this box had a real same-file collision incident earlier today (two Claude sessions editing the same PARENA file, S190-03) -- this agent could not write to or git-commit against PARENA's shared checkout at all (hard sandboxing boundary, not a policy choice), so stdlib/pitviper/vterm_mod.prn was written+compiled from a copy inside this worktree and needs to be copied to its real destination (PARENA/stdlib/pitviper/vterm_mod.prn) and committed there by whoever has access to that checkout -- flagged clearly, not silently worked around.

⚓ ☃
title: PITVIPER mod-surface v0: wheel-scroll fix delivered as the first real PARENA mod
